        uint16(0) == 0x5A4D and // MZ header
        $beacon_config and
        $c2_uri_get and
        $user_agent
}

arguments.summary: A data exfiltration attempt was detected from host WS-IT-101 (10.0.2.15) to an external IP (10.0.5.14) via DNS tunneling using the domain c2.evil-example.com. Investigation revealed that the source of the C2 domain was WS-FIN-042 (10.0.5.42), a high-criticality finance workstation infected with Cobalt Strike. The compromised host performed network scanning, lateral movement via SMB, and attempted Kerberos TGT requests. No malicious payload was found on the exfiltration source host, but the C2 activity and lateral movement indicate a broader compromise.
